data.name: Madhu
data.gender_notes: Madhu is used as a unisex name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit madhu, 'honey, sweet, spring'. Its root is Sanskrit madhu (मधु). A classical Sanskrit term for honey. Madhu is a Sanskrit name meaning “Honey; sweet; spring”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Madhu expresses “Honey; sweet; spring”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit madhu, 'honey, sweet, spring'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Madhu total 20, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
